title: QUALITY AREA COORDINATOR | UNIVERSITY TECHNICIAN IN MINING AND METALLURGY

aboutMe.title: About me
aboutMe.content: Professional with a technical background in mining and metallurgy, currently studying Industrial Maintenance Engineering. Oriented towards industrial maintenance, operational reliability, and data analysis applied to production processes, with a focus on operational continuity, failure analysis, process control, and continuous improvement. Has experience in quality inspection, deviation diagnosis, technical documentation, operational safety, and production process support, integrating digital tools to strengthen planning, indicator tracking, and standardizing technical procedures.

descriptions: Coordinated quality assurance activities, including component inspection and control of critical conditions, to contribute to the operational continuity of production processes.
Designed and implemented a Python model to analyze operational data and monitor KPIs, facilitating decision-making in the quality and production areas.
Standardized response protocols for operational deviations, improving the traceability of corrective actions, document control, and compliance with quality criteria.

Developed a local interactive platform with Python and Streamlit to automate the generation of technical data sheets, integrating databases with costs, raw material consumption, and man-hours per process.
Implemented the monthly tracking of key indicators, relating the volume of effective production with detected deviations to establish performance and quality metrics.
Reviewed plans prepared by the Technical Office team, verifying their consistency with the information and requirements provided by the Commercial area.
Trained new quality inspectors on production processes, raw materials, control methods, and technical acceptance criteria.
Supported industrial trials with different suppliers and prepared technical reports with their results and conclusions.
Consolidated quality controls by sales note to generate production reports and ensure result traceability.
Defined, along with the IT area, the parameters, tolerances, and functional rules to digitally integrate the controls performed by quality inspectors.
Audited the operational and indication parameters of the presses, promoting the unification of magnitudes and a clearer visualization for operators.
Prepared and debugged data to facilitate operational migration to the Oracle NetSuite ERP.
Performed root cause analysis (RCA) on production line failures, identifying mechanical and operational deviations and proposing preventive actions to reduce their recurrence.
Developed technical manuals and inspection procedures aimed at safeguarding the mechanical integrity of equipment, supporting maintenance routines, and promoting safe execution.
Supervised metallurgical recovery cycles in the leaching and electrowinning stages, controlling operational variables to safeguard continuity, safety, and process performance.
Supported the safe handling of chemical agents and plant operation, ensuring compliance with industrial safety procedures, operational order, and risk control.
Executed, under supervision, compaction, granulometry, consistency limits, and compression tests on concrete specimens.
Accompanied field sampling activities and reviewed technical backgrounds in laboratory public tenders.
